stable_boundaries: AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, fallback, retry, model-card management, and the base shared Dashboard schema.
The plugin adapts Volcengine request and media protocols; it does not maintain a second global model-capability database.
The user-facing Video truth remains the native per-model-card modalities selection scoped to the two plugin-owned Source types.
Foreign Provider dialogs must never receive plugin Video or volcengine_* model-card fields.
Request transport settings are not permanent model-capability facts.
Local video materialization must reject empty and oversized input before base64 encoding and bound ffmpeg work with timeout plus kill-on-cancel.
CHANGELOG.md ships with the runtime package because AstrBot renders the post-update changelog popup from it.
Development documentation, tests, evidence and experiments stay outside the allow-list runtime package.
A passing repository gate proves only the named repository/runtime boundary; marketplace cache and real user installations remain separate observations.
